Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the date format from the Wikipedia page. Wikipedia lists Mauro Scocco's birth date as "11 September 1962" (Day Month Year). The Planner converted this to "11/09/1962" assuming MM/DD/YYYY format (which would mean November 9, 1962), whereas the correct MM/DD/YYYY representation of September 11, 1962, is 09/11/1962. This error occurred in the analysis of the Wikipedia result, leading to a misrepresentation of the date in subsequent steps.
